title: Red Hat Security Advisory: libXtst security update
description: A denial of service vulnerability (CVE-2026-94286) exists in the X.Org X11 libXtst runtime library due to an out-of-bounds read in the RECORD reply parser. This flaw can cause the affected application to crash or become unresponsive. Red Hat has issued an important security update addressing this issue in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.2 and related variants.
